text:
mira: heads up — deploybot preflight flagged compat-bridge mismatch on quant-v2 builds in staging :warning:

deploybot: preflight: kernel-bridge v3 != runtime-abi v2 on 3 hosts (stg-us-west-2)

mira: stacktrace snippet:
```
E KERNEL: bridge_init: expected ABI 3, got 2
E QUANT: load_kernel: incompatible symbol table
```

cheng: repro steps? I can grab a pod and run `ldd`/`nm` checks
mira: repro: `deploybot apply --env=staging --bundle=quant-v2-2026-03-19`
mira: affected hosts: stg-gpu-14, stg-gpu-17, stg-gpu-21

cheng: looks like the builder picked up a newer kernel-bridge on the image bake. I'll check build tags. prob mismatch between kernel-bridge:3 and runtime:2

infra-bot: image-bake #882 completed by ci-bot at 2324992000; tags: quant-v2-2026-03-19, kernel-bridge:3

tamsin: proposal: pin runtime to runtime-abi:3 on staging or roll back bake to kernel-bridge:2. Which is lower blast radius?

julian: pin runtime for quick fix; rollback bake for full fix. We need a canary window + smoke

cheng: agreed. I'll push a quick pin to staging and run smoke tests (50 reqs) in 15m
mira: @julian @tamsin @sre-oncall set change window 2325006000-2325009600? (1h)
julian: :thumbsup: set. add a note in release-notes channel after we confirm

mira: smoke results: 50/50 requests passed, latency ok. rolling canary to 10% traffic now.
deploybot: canary shift initiated: 10% -> 30% over 10m
mira: monitor traces + kv-cache hits closely; if error rate >0.5% rollback

cheng: found root cause: bake's linker picked updated symbol; pushing fixed bake with kernel-bridge:2, starting image rebuild

infra-bot: image-bake #883 queued

tamsin: if #883 is good, schedule full swap during nightly window, otherwise keep pin and notify customers

mira: adding brief blurb to release-notes/digest: "hotfix: runtime pin to maintain compat with quant-v2 bake; full rebuild underway" :memo:
julian: thanks everyone. will keep this thread as the single-source for rollback decision
mira: closing loop: full rebuild passed in staging, plan to flip in night window. marking thread resolved :white_check_mark:
